subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/985132f1f1d92fa11a5f660c5b22fd14b5601f7dec6f7ebc11e6ace986769268.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• @ is moving in clockwise direction one step ahead.
 
• O is moving in anticlockwise direction +1, +2, +3, .. step ahead.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01774f9cb35b842bc36f1705fcdad42e8cd6cd2593f1a1ab559b61871c88727c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
